property: A task has at most one recorded lock owner. A gate can complete only an approved task after PASS; drift, tamper, and the repair limit constrain the next action.

actions.Acquire: acquireLock: claim a writer intent before atomically publishing the lock
actions.ReclaimStale: acquireLock: replace an expired record under the writer intent
actions.Release: releaseLock: matching, non-empty recorded owner under the writer intent

actions.CompleteImpl: tasks.md Status: In Progress -> Implementation Complete
actions.RunGateFail: run-sdd-gate.mjs verdict FAIL, including a blocking Concept Test decision or missing Concept Test runtime before project commands
actions.Approve: Human approval in tasks.md, read by the shared task parser before gate execution
actions.Repair: ship repair round below max_auto_fix_rounds after failed gate
actions.Escalate: runFormalGate or checkAntiTampering records a provisional question and stops

actions.Announce: withLockMutation: publish a unique intent with wx

actions.Reap: withLockMutation: remove the unique intent of a local PID confirmed dead

assumptions: Local atomic exclusive creation, atomic rename, and coherent directory enumeration; every writer uses the same intent protocol. Local peers with the same hostname share a PID namespace.
Only quality-gate sets Status: Done after reading execution.json verdict
excluded: Manual human override via git commit
Explicit operator recovery with task-lock release --force; malformed or ownerless records refuse ordinary Release.
bounds: Two lock contenders; abstract, indivisible filesystem operations; holders includes the owner of a stale record until reclaimed.
One task; max two automatic retry rounds; terminal Done and Blocked states; finite safety properties only.

TaskLockMutation models three concurrent local operations, with unique intent identities and accurate local PID death detection. Enter abstracts the directory scan after publication; a live peer present for the entire scan is observed. It checks exclusion only.
source_sync_note: source_sync_commit is the committed predecessor used for this comparison. source_sha256 identifies the reviewed implementation bytes, including the changes on top of that commit. Recheck the action mapping and traces before updating a source digest.
